findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_usdt_subscription · Private data: create_usdt_invoice, verify_usdt_invoice, verify_onchain_transfer · Public sink: verify_usdt_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_usdt_subscription · Private data: create_usdt_invoice, verify_usdt_invoice, verify_onchain_transfer · Public sink: verify_usdt_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
